adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService` the new `refreshAccessToken` path assigns `res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the result of `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` in sync mode, i.e. a native `Response` object which has no `.data` property. That makes `token` undefined and `token.access_token` will throw at runtime when sync mode is enabled.
